terms.heading: Membership terms
terms.standfirst: How membership works, in plain words, kept as it should be: clear, and without surprises.

nodes.html: Welcome. These terms explain how TripAgent membership works. By accepting an invitation and becoming a member, you agree to them.
Your membership

TripAgent membership gives you a named travel advisor and Tara, our AI travel agent, who together plan, book and look after your flights, hotels and visas. Membership is personal to you and offered at our discretion.
The complimentary period, and what happens after

items: Membership is by invitation. Each invitation carries a one-time code that grants a complimentary period, set per invitation, ranging from three months to twelve months, with the full service, at no membership fee.
No card is taken when you redeem your invitation, and nothing is charged during the complimentary period.
After the complimentary period, membership continues only if you choose to continue it. We will write to you with the annual fee before it applies, and nothing is ever charged automatically.
We write to you before your complimentary period ends, so nothing about it is ever a surprise.

nodes.html: Cancelling

Cancel at any time, message your advisor or write to maison@tripsure.com. Cancel before your complimentary period ends and you are charged nothing. Cancel during a paid year and your membership runs to the end of that year; it simply does not renew.
What the fee covers, and what it doesn’t

The membership fee covers your membership: the advisor relationship and Tara. Travel itself, air fares, hotel rooms, visa government fees, is paid per trip, transparently, with taxes shown. We never add hidden markups; any service fee is disclosed before you confirm.
Bookings & suppliers

Flights, hotels and visas are provided by airlines, hotels, bedbanks and government authorities. Their own terms, fare rules and timelines apply to each booking. Your advisor makes these clear before you commit.
Using the service well
Please give accurate traveller details and use the service for lawful, personal travel. We may decline or end a membership that is misused.
Our responsibility

We take great care, but are not liable for events outside our control (airline cancellations, weather, government decisions). Where we are responsible, our liability is limited to the membership fee you have paid. Nothing here limits rights you have under Indian law.
Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of India; disputes are subject to the courts of Bangalore, India.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.standfirst: Your trust is the thing we look after most. Here is what we hold, why, and the control you keep.

nodes.html: This explains what we collect, why we collect it, and the control you keep over it, under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
What we collect

items: You give us: name, email, mobile, city, how you travel, and trip details you share with your advisor.
To take payment: card or UPI details are entered directly with our payment processor, Razorpay. We do not see or store your card number.
Automatically: basic, privacy-respecting usage data to keep the site working.

nodes.html: Why we use it
To plan and book your travel, introduce your advisor, take the membership fee, send you trip and service messages, and meet legal and tax obligations in India.
Our lawful basis (India DPDP)
We process your data with your consent and to provide the service you asked for, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. You may withdraw consent at any time.
Who we share it with

Only as needed to serve you: your advisor; the airlines, hotels and visa authorities required to complete a booking; our payment processor; and our technology providers under confidentiality. We do not sell your data.
How long we keep it
For as long as you are a member and as long as the law requires (tax and booking records), then we delete or anonymise it.
Your rights
Ask us to show, correct or delete your data, or to withdraw consent, write to maison@tripsure.com and we act promptly.
Security
We hold your data on bank-grade infrastructure with access controls and encryption in transit. Payments run on PCI-compliant rails.

refund.heading: Refund of fees
refund.standfirst: Plainly stated, because that is how it should be.

nodes.html: Where our membership fee and the travel you book are concerned, here is exactly how refunds work.
The complimentary period

Membership is by invitation. Each invitation carries a complimentary period, set per invitation, from three to twelve months, at no membership fee. Cancel before it ends and you are charged nothing; there is nothing to refund.
The annual membership fee

items: If a fee is charged in error, or within 7 days of a charge you have not used, write to us and we refund it in full.
Otherwise the annual fee is non-refundable, but cancelling stops the next renewal, you keep the service to the end of the year already paid.

nodes.html: Refunds on travel you booked

Air fares, hotel rooms and visa fees follow the airline’s, hotel’s or authority’s own rules, some refundable, some not. Your advisor tells you the cancellation terms before you confirm, and handles any eligible refund for you, chasing it to completion.
How to request
Message your advisor or email maison@tripsure.com. Approved refunds return to your original payment method, typically within 5, 7 business days.
